turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Adrian Lim speaking. Hello, Ms Tan. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer that I call you back?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Adrian, Elaine here. I'm in my office with the door closed, so now is fine. I've got my notes beside me. My NRIC is S nine six three one one five five W. My date of birth is 6 June 1955.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll complete the account check here. We can keep the conversation fairly concise since you're at work.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, thank you. I went through the list beforehand. I reviewed Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, which is the bond option on the list. I also reviewed Meridian Asia Equity Fund, which is the regional equity option. I'd like to proceed with the regional equity option I just mentioned, rather than the bond option.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: So your objective is long-term capital growth through Asian equities, and you don't need to draw on these funds in the near term. Can you confirm that you're willing to accept investment losses and fluctuations in value while pursuing that long-term growth?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses and fluctuations for long-term growth, and I recognise that recovery isn't assured.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Meridian Asia Equity Fund because its Asian equity exposure fits your long-term growth objective, while professional management suits your preference not to select and monitor individual companies. I've got your earlier discussion notes open alongside your account.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Before we finish, can we sort out the routine review calls as well? My mornings tend to get taken up by staff matters, and it's difficult to step away halfway through.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. For routine reviews, would an afternoon call be more convenient? We can arrange a suitable slot beforehand rather than calling when you're in the middle of something.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Tuesday afternoons are usually better, after lunch. Just send me a message first, please. Sometimes a supplier drops by, and I may need to move the appointment.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that as your contact preference. When arranging a review, I'll message first, and you can let me know which afternoon slot works that week.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks. Back to my notes. For this transaction, use Chinese yuan as the currency. The total amount I'm committing to this transaction is 750,000. The quantity for my transaction is 10,000 units.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'm listening. We can also cover your correspondence preferences while you're on the line, if there's anything you'd like checked.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, digital correspondence is much more convenient. Paper tends to sit in my office tray, especially when I'm busy with the business.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Do you currently have access to your secure banking inbox?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I can log in without any trouble. To be clear about the direction, I want to buy the fund I've selected. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your final instruction is to buy 10,000 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund, for a total amount of 750,000 in Chinese yuan, using a market order. Can you explicitly confirm that instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you've stated it. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. On the correspondence point, I'll check the preference currently recorded on your account. If anything needs updating, I'll send you the relevant administrative steps.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would be helpful. I prefer keeping the paperwork in one place rather than having to search between my email and the office files.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted. For our next routine review, I'll message ahead as discussed. Anything else on the account administration today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, that's all for now. Thanks, Adrian. Have a good afternoon.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome, Ms Tan. Thank you for calling, and enjoy the rest of your day. Goodbye.
